events.text: {"verdict":"needs_adi","decision":"Keep T-335 as the single Adi input for Live Control, with the ask unchanged (SDK app credentials plus the 5 poll scopes in one Zoom sign-in). Ignore the 2026-10-11T23:43 ripple note asking to strip the poll scopes: O-695a03c5 folded them in because no Zoom-signed-in browser was available. Do not create the Zoom app yourself. Meanwhile keep everything else moving on T-226: seat build scripts ready to pull ZoomSDK.framework into cloud/seat/Frameworks, run sheets saved, probe-live-control green. Each run, read https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/admin/api/zoom/control with centre_admin.py. Once the Seat credentials card reads saved and all 5 poll scopes read present, mark T-335 done, build the seat app and run the T-226 test meeting. If a Zoom-signed-in browser turns up first, add the 5 scopes yourself and shrink the ask to the credentials only.","why":"~/.config/tantra holds only zoom-bot-key, no Meeting SDK Client ID or Secret. T-226 and T-407 (2026-10-11) confirm zoom_sdk_enc absent in production. Creating a Zoom app credential needs Adi's sign-in to an outside service.","outward_ok":[],"reassign_to_claude":false,"adi_input":{"ask":"Sign in at https://marketplace.zoom.us once. (1) At https://marketplace.zoom.us/develop/create create General App 'Tantra Live Control' (Features, Embed, Meeting SDK on, do not publish), then paste its Client ID and Client Secret at https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/admin/control in the Seat credentials card and click Save. (2) In the same sign-in: Manage, Tantra Centre, Scopes, add meeting:write:poll:admin, meeting:update:poll:admin, meeting:delete:poll:admin, meeting:read:list_polls:admin, meeting:read:list_poll_results:admin, Save.","kind":"credential","why_only_adi":"Needs Adi's Zoom login and 2FA and creates a new credential on his account; the keys exist nowhere on this Mac."}}
